about: Real answers from OpenAI Chat Completions to the prompts in server/src/plugins/grant-translate.ts, over Composio's own Gmail listing (composio-gmail-catalogue.json, each action's effect and destructive flag read by effectOf in plugins/composio.ts). Each string is the assistant message content exactly as the model returned it, recorded 2026-11-09. gpt-5.6-terra is the deployment default, asked with response_format json_schema, whose action names are an enum of the app's own. fixedOnRetry is gpt-4o-mini asked without a schema (response_format json_object), as a plan or a gateway that refuses schemas is asked: with the enum a strict provider cannot answer a name the app does not have, so that is where the check earns its keep. Its description names two actions Gmail does not have; the model copied them, and the check sent them back.
